readings: Join `player_college` to `player` on `player_id`, excluding attendance records with no matching player. Count attendance records for each `birth_country` and divide each country’s count by the total count across all countries to get its share. Select countries whose record count exceeds the average country record count. Return one row with the sum of their record counts, the arithmetic mean of their shares, and the arithmetic mean of the amount by which their record counts exceed that average. Do not round.

Join `player_college` to `player` on `player_id`, excluding attendance records with no matching player. Count distinct players represented in the attendance records for each `birth_country` and divide each country’s count by the total of those country counts to get its share. Select countries whose distinct-player count exceeds the average country distinct-player count. Return one row with the sum of their country counts, the arithmetic mean of their shares, and the arithmetic mean of the amount by which their country counts exceed that average. Do not round.
queries:
WITH country_counts AS (
    SELECT p.birth_country, COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM player_college AS pc
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = pc.player_id
    GROUP BY p.birth_country
),
country_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(record_count) AS average_count,
           SUM(record_count) AS total_count
    FROM country_counts
)
SELECT SUM(cc.record_count),
       AVG(1.0 * cc.record_count / ca.total_count),
       AVG(cc.record_count - ca.average_count)
FROM country_counts AS cc
CROSS JOIN country_average AS ca
WHERE cc.record_count > ca.average_count

WITH country_counts AS (
    SELECT p.birth_country, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.player_id) AS player_count
    FROM player_college AS pc
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = pc.player_id
    GROUP BY p.birth_country
),
country_stats AS (
    SELECT AVG(player_count) AS average_count,
           SUM(player_count) AS total_count
    FROM country_counts
)
SELECT SUM(c.player_count) AS sum_country_counts,
       AVG(1.0 * c.player_count / s.total_count) AS mean_share,
       AVG(c.player_count - s.average_count) AS mean_excess
FROM country_counts AS c
CROSS JOIN country_stats AS s
WHERE c.player_count > s.average_count
